resources.string:
VegamShare uses Wireless Debugging (Android 11+) to start a privileged helper that can access Android/data — no PC or root needed.

1. Go to Settings → Developer options.
 (To unlock: Settings → About phone → tap Build number 7 times.)

2. Enable Wireless debugging.

3. Tap "Pair device with pairing code".

Leave the Wireless debugging screen open and tap Continue.
In Wireless debugging → "Pair device with pairing code", you see an IP:port and a 6-digit code. Enter them below.
Enter the pairing port shown on your phone.
Connecting to ADB and starting server…
Server started. You can now send/receive apps with data!\n\nAfter a reboot you will need to run Setup again (Wireless Debugging only stays active until reboot).
